## The question {#question}

::: {.nhh}
::: {.box .have}
What do we have?

- 4 trees: inflow **A**, **P**, outflow **V**, **B** (`<tree>.arrow`)
- per edge $k=(i,j)$: diameter $d_k$, length $l_k$, ODE group, predecessors / successors
- known pressures at the tree roots: A 80, P 10, V 3, B 4 mmHg
:::

::: {.arrow}
→
:::

::: {.box .how}
How?

- every edge is a **Poiseuille tube**: flow $\propto$ pressure difference
- **mass conservation** at every node → one linear equation per edge
- boundary rows: inflows $Q$, pressure drops, common terminal pressure
- one **sparse linear system** $A\,x = b$
:::

::: {.arrow}
→
:::

::: {.box .need}
What for?

- **pressure** in every node, **flow** in every edge
- flows from the geometry instead of assumed flow values
- input for the pharmacokinetic simulation
:::
:::

## Poiseuille flow in one edge {#poiseuille}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="55%"}
::: {.text-06}
Edge $k = (i, j)$, flow from node $i$ to node $j$:

$$
q_k = c_k\,(p_i - p_j),
\qquad
c_k = \frac{\pi\, d_k^4}{128\,\mu\, l_k}
$$

| symbol | meaning | unit |
|:--|:--|:--|
| $p_i$ | pressure at node $i$ | Pa |
| $c_k$ | hydraulic conductance | L/(Pa·s) |
| $\mu = 3.71\cdot10^{-3}$ | blood viscosity | Pa·s |
| $d_k,\ l_k$ | diameter, length | mm |
| $q_k$ | volume flow | L/s |

- pressures in **Pa**: tree pressures in mmHg are multiplied by `MMHG_TO_PA` $=133.322$
- $c \propto d^4$: halving the diameter → **16×** less flow
:::
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}
```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 200" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Edge from node i to node j with flow q">
  <defs><marker id="arrP" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="10" refX="9" refY="5" orient="auto">
    <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#2b6cb0"/></marker></defs>
  <rect x="80" y="80" width="260" height="40" rx="20" fill="#ebf8ff" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="2"/>
```

## Edges, groups and orientation {#groups}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.text-06}
**ODE groups** (column `ODE_groups`)

| code | edge | in the pressure system |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 0 | marginal $(0,i)$ / $(i,0)$ | boundary row ($Q$ / outflow) |
| 1 | inner | conservation row |
| 2 | preterminal, ends in a leaf | leaf pressure → terminal row |
| 3 | terminal self-edge $(n,n)$ | not used |

**Orientation**: edges point in the direction of the flow

- **inflow** (A, P): root edge $(0, i)$, flow **splits** towards the leaves
- **outflow** (V, B): stored **reversed**, root edge $(i, 0)$, flow **merges** towards the outlet
- node $0$ is outside the tree → **no column**
:::
:::

## Unknowns and the layout of the matrix {#unknowns}

::: {.text-06}
**Unknowns** $x$: one pressure per node of every tree, then one inflow per inflow tree

$$
x = \big(\underbrace{p^{A}_1,\dots,p^{A}_{n_A}}_{\text{tree A}},\;
\underbrace{p^{P}_1,\dots}_{\text{tree P}},\;
\underbrace{p^{V}_1,\dots}_{\text{tree V}},\;
\underbrace{p^{B}_1,\dots}_{\text{tree B}},\;
Q_A,\; Q_P\big)
$$

- **columns**: tree $t$ uses columns $\text{col\_offset}_t + 1, \dots, \text{col\_offset}_t + n_t$, then the $Q$ columns after all pressures
- **rows**: tree $t$ uses one row per edge, $\text{row\_offset}_t + k$ for edge $k$; boundary rows follow after all tree blocks
- offsets grow tree by tree in the order of `tree_info.vascular_trees`
:::

```{=html}
<table class="mat">
<tr><th></th><th>p<sup>A</sup></th><th>p<sup>P</sup></th><th>p<sup>V</sup></th><th>p<sup>B</sup></th><th>Q<sub>A</sub>, Q<sub>P</sub></th><th>b</th></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">edges of A</th><td class="A">C<sub>A</sub></td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="A">+1 (root row)</td><td class="e">0</td></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">edges of P</th><td class="e">0</td><td class="P">C<sub>P</sub></td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="P">+1 (root row)</td><td class="e">0</td></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">edges of V</th><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="V">C<sub>V</sub></td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">edges of B</th><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="B">C<sub>B</sub></td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">outflow balance</th><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="V">± c</td><td class="B">± c</td><td class="g">−1, −1</td><td class="e">0</td></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">pressure drops</th><td class="A">+1</td><td class="P">+1</td><td class="V">−1</td><td class="B">−1</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="T">ΔP</td></tr>
<tr><th style="text-align:right">common leaf pressure</th><td class="A">±1</td><td class="P">±1</td><td class="V">±1</td><td class="B">±1</td><td class="e">0</td><td class="e">0</td></tr>
</table>
```

## Inner edges of an inflow tree: flow splits {#inner-inflow}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 420 230" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Edge k from i to j splits into successors s1 to h1 and s2 to h2">
  <defs><marker id="arrI" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,4.5 L0,9 z" fill="#c53030"/></marker></defs>
  <circle cx="50" cy="115" r="20" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2"/><text x="50" y="121" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18">i</text>
  <circle cx="210" cy="115" r="20" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="3"/><text x="210" y="121" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18">j</text>
  <circle cx="370" cy="45" r="20" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="51" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16">h₁</text>
  <circle cx="370" cy="185" r="20" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="191" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16">h₂</text>
  <line x1="72" y1="115" x2="185" y2="115" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrI)"/>
  <line x1="230" y1="105" x2="347" y2="55" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrI)"/>
  <line x1="230" y1="125" x2="347" y2="175" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrI)"/>
  <text x="128" y="103" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16">k: c<tspan font-size="11" dy="4">k</tspan></text>
  <text x="290" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">s₁</text>
  <text x="290" y="175" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">s₂</text>
  <text x="210" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#4a5568">shared node</text>
</svg>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.text-06}
Edge $k=(i,j)\in E_1$, successors $s=(j,h)\in N^{+}(k)$

flow into $j$ = flow out of $j$:

$$
c_k\,(p_i - p_j) \;=\; \sum_{s=(j,h)\in N^{+}(k)} c_s\,(p_j - p_h)
$$

row $\text{row\_offset}+k$, everything on the left:

$$
c_k\,p_i \;-\;\Big(c_k + \sum_s c_s\Big)\,p_j \;+\; \sum_s c_s\,p_h \;=\; 0
$$
:::
:::
::::

::: {.small .center .muted}
the row of edge $k$ is the conservation law at its **end node** $j$ — `add_equations!`, `is_inflow = true`
:::

```{=html}
  <circle cx="210" cy="115" r="20" fill="#cfe0f3" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="3"/><text x="210" y="121" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18">i</text>
  <circle cx="370" cy="115" r="20" fill="#cfe0f3" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="2"/><text x="370" y="121" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18">j</text>
  <line x1="70" y1="55" x2="187" y2="105" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="175" x2="187" y2="125" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <line x1="232" y1="115" x2="345" y2="115" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <text x="290" y="103" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16">k: c<tspan font-size="11" dy="4">k</tspan></text>
  <text x="130" y="65" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">s₁</text>
  <text x="130" y="175" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">s₂</text>
  <text x="210" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#4a5568">shared node</text>
</svg>
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.text-06}
Edge $k=(i,j)\in E_1$, predecessors $s=(g,i)\in N^{-}(k)$

flow into $i$ = flow out of $i$:

$$
c_k\,(p_i - p_j) \;=\; \sum_{s=(g,i)\in N^{-}(k)} c_s\,(p_g - p_i)
$$

row $\text{row\_offset}+k$:

$$
\Big(c_k + \sum_s c_s\Big)\,p_i \;-\; c_k\,p_j \;-\; \sum_s c_s\,p_g \;=\; 0
$$
:::
:::
::::

::: {.small .center .muted}
the row of edge $k$ is the conservation law at its **start node** $i$ — `add_equations!`, `is_inflow = false`
:::

## One function for both directions {#unified}

::: {.text-06}
Both rows have the same shape: own edge term + one term per neighbour.
Only the **shared node**, the **far node** and one **sign** $\sigma$ differ:

| | neighbours | shared node | far node of $s$ | $\sigma$ | coefficient of $p_\text{far}$ | coefficient of $p_\text{shared}$ |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| inflow | successors $(j,h)$ | $j$ | $h$ | $+1$ | $+c_s$ | $-c_s$ |
| outflow | predecessors $(g,i)$ | $i$ | $g$ | $-1$ | $-c_s$ | $+c_s$ |

$$
\text{row of } k:\qquad
c_k\,p_i - c_k\,p_j \;+\; \sum_{s} \sigma\,c_s\,\big(p_{\text{far}(s)} - p_{\text{shared}}\big) \;=\; 0
$$

- only **group 1** edges get this row; rows of groups 0, 2, 3 stay empty here
- the shared node collects several entries ($-c_k$, $-c_{s_1}$, $-c_{s_2}$, …) → summed when the matrix is built
- a neighbour that does not touch the shared node → `@warn` (consistency check of the table)
:::

## Inflow boundary: the unknown inflow $Q_t$ {#inflow-bc}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="45%"}
```{=html}
<svg viewBox="0 0 380 220" width="100%" role="img" aria-label="Inflow Q enters through root edge 0 to i and splits into successors">
  <defs><marker id="arrQ" markerWidth="9" markerHeight="9" refX="8" refY="4.5" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L9,4.5 L0,9 z" fill="#c53030"/></marker></defs>
  <circle cx="40" cy="110" r="18" fill="#fff" stroke="#a0aec0" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/><text x="40" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16">0</text>
  <circle cx="180" cy="110" r="20" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="3"/><text x="180" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18">i</text>
  <circle cx="330" cy="45" r="18" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2"/><text x="330" y="51" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">h₁</text>
  <circle cx="330" cy="175" r="18" fill="#f9d0d0" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2"/><text x="330" y="181" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15">h₂</text>
  <line x1="60" y1="110" x2="155" y2="110" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4" marker-end="url(#arrQ)"/>
  <line x1="200" y1="100" x2="310" y2="55" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrQ)"/>
  <line x1="200" y1="120" x2="310" y2="165" stroke="#c53030" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrQ)"/>
  <text x="108" y="98" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#c53030">Q<tspan font-size="12" dy="4">t</tspan></text>
  <text x="108" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#718096">group 0</text>
</svg>
```
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
::: {.text-06}
Root edge $k_0=(0,i)$ of inflow tree $t$ — node $0$ has no pressure.
The flow through it is a **new unknown** $Q_t$:

$$
Q_t \;=\; \sum_{s=(i,h)\in N^{+}(k_0)} c_s\,(p_i - p_h)
$$

$$
1\cdot Q_t \;+\; \sum_s c_s\,p_h \;-\; \sum_s c_s\,p_i \;=\; 0
$$

- written in the (otherwise empty) row $\text{row\_offset}_t + k_0$
- column of $Q_t$: after all pressure columns
- the conductance of the root edge itself is **not used**
:::
:::
::::

::: {.small .center .muted}
`add_inflow_boundary!` — one per inflow tree, exactly one marginal edge per tree
:::

```{=html}
  <line x1="58" y1="165" x2="168" y2="120" stroke="#2b6cb0" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrB)"/>
  <line x1="212" y1="110" x2="312" y2="110" stroke="#a0aec0" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="6,4" marker-end="url(#arrB)"/>
  <text x="262" y="140" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" fill="#718096">not in the matrix</text>
</svg>
```
:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
::: {.text-06}
Root edge $(i_t, 0)$ of outflow tree $t$: its flow = flow from its **predecessors** into $i_t$.
**One** row for all trees:

$$
\sum_{t\,\in\,\text{out}}\;\sum_{s=(g,\,i_t)\in N^{-}(k_0^t)} c_s\,(p_g - p_{i_t})
\;-\; \sum_{t\,\in\,\text{in}} Q_t \;=\; 0
$$

- every outflow tree writes into the **same row**, the entries are summed
- $-Q_t$ is pushed **once** per inflow tree
- the root edge (conductance, node $0$) never enters the matrix
- row: first row after all tree blocks
:::
:::
::::

::: {.small .center .muted}
`add_outflow_boundary!` — called after the loop over the trees, with the stored column offset of each tree
:::

## Pressure drops between the trees {#pressure-drops}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.text-06}
Root nodes: $r_t$ = real node of the marginal edge (`marginal_node`)

Only a **spanning set** of (inflow, outflow) pairs: first inflow with every outflow,
first outflow with every other inflow → $n_\text{in}+n_\text{out}-1$ rows:

$$
p_{r_a} - p_{r_b} \;=\; \big(P_a - P_b\big)\cdot 133.322
\qquad a\in\text{in},\ b\in\text{out}
$$

$P_t$ from `TreePressures` (mmHg) → right side $b$ in Pa
:::
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.text-06}
`Rectangle_quad` (in: A, P · out: V, B)

| row | equation | $b$ [mmHg] | $b$ [Pa] |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| A–V | $p_{r_A} - p_{r_V}$ | 77 | 10 266 |
| A–B | $p_{r_A} - p_{r_B}$ | 76 | 10 132 |
| P–V | $p_{r_P} - p_{r_V}$ | 7 | 933 |
| ~~P–B~~ | dropped: P–B = A–B + P–V − A–V | 6 | — |

`Rectangle_trio`: A–V, P–V (nothing dropped)
:::

`add_pressure_drop_boundary!` — with the absolute pressure row, the only rows with a non-zero right side

:::

::: {.column width="55%"}
::: {.text-06}
Leaves $L$ = end nodes of all preterminal (group 2) edges, **all trees**:

- inflow edge $(i, j)$ → leaf $j$
- outflow edge $(i, j)$ (reversed) → leaf $i$

All leaves have the **same pressure** — no matching of terminals between trees:

$$
p_{\ell_1} - p_{\ell} \;=\; 0 \qquad \forall\, \ell \in L\setminus\{\ell_1\}
$$

- $|L| - 1$ rows, right side $0$
- only the tree `.arrow` tables are used (no `T.arrow`, no `synch_idx`)
- the whole capillary bed acts as **one node**
:::
:::

`add_terminal_pressure_boundary!`

## Absolute pressure: fix $p_1$ of tree A {#absolute}

::: {.text-06}
All rows so far contain only **differences** → $p \to p + C$ is a null vector. One more row fixes the level:

$$
p^{A}_1 \;=\; P_A \cdot 133.322 \;=\; 80 \cdot 133.322 \;=\; 10\,666\ \text{Pa}
$$

- node 1 of tree A: column $\text{col\_offset}_A + 1$, one entry $+1$, right side in Pa
- written after the terminal rows
- with it every pressure is fixed by the pressure drops, so the other three root pressures follow
:::

## Assembly: entries → sparse matrix {#assembly}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.text-06}
Every equation is written as **entries** (COO format), never cell by cell:

| vector | meaning |
|:--|:--|
| `rows` | equation (matrix row) |
| `cols` | unknown (matrix column) |
| `values` | coefficient |
| `labels` | same entry as text, e.g. `-c1,2` |

$$
A_{rc} \;=\; \sum_{n:\ \text{rows}[n]=r,\ \text{cols}[n]=c} \text{values}[n]
$$

`sparse(…)` sums duplicates → the shared node gets $-c_k-\sum c_s$ automatically;
no slow cell-by-cell insertion into a `SparseMatrixCSC`.
:::
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.code-xs}
```julia
for (id, df) in tree_dfs            # order of vascular_trees
    add_equations!(…, row_offset, col_offset)     # group 1
    if is_inflow
        add_inflow_boundary!(…, q_col)            # Q_t
    end
    store marginal column, leaf columns
    row_offset += n_edges;  col_offset += n_nodes
end
outflow balance row       # all outflow trees, -ΣQ
pressure-drop rows        # spanning (in, out) pairs, b ≠ 0
common leaf pressure rows # p_ℓ1 - p_ℓ = 0
absolute pressure row     # p_1(A) = 80 mmHg
compact empty rows / columns
A = sparse(rows, cols, values, n_rows, n_cols)
html_report && write_matrix_html_report(…)
```
:::

::: {.small .muted}
HTML report (`html_report = true`): symbolic matrix, diagonal highlighted, click a row/column label to highlight it
:::
:::

## Proposed step: leaf pressure per tree {#proposal}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.text-06}
**Change**: leaves of **one tree** share a pressure $p_{\ell,t}$, different trees may differ

$p_{\ell_{t,1}} - p_{\ell_{t,m}} = 0$ for every leaf $m>1$ of tree $t$ → $L_t-1$ rows per tree

| step (`Rectangle_quad_500`) | rows | still missing |
|:--|--:|--:|
| unknowns | | 4378 |
| tree rows (A, P, V, B) | 547 + 547 + 546 + 546 | 2192 |
| outflow balance | 1 | 2191 |
| pressure drops (spanning) | 3 | 2188 |
| leaf rows **per tree**: $4\cdot(547-1)$ | 2184 | **4** |
| absolute pressure $p^A_1$ | 1 | **3** |

before: leaf rows $\sum L_t - 1 = 2187$ → $T-1 = 3$ rows fewer

**3 more rows needed** (trio: $T-1 = 2$)
:::
:::

::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.text-06}
**What do we know, what can we change**

| now | alternatives |
|:--|:--|
| root pressures of all 4 trees: 3 differences + $p^A_1$ | replace by **flows**, e.g. $Q_A$, $Q_P$ given |
| leaf pressure: one common value (unknown) | **per tree**, then fix 3 more: |
| | – total flow $Q_A + Q_P = Q_\text{tot}$ |
| | – splits $A{:}P$ and $V{:}B$ |
| | – leaf pressure of a tree given |
| | – leaves of different trees coupled by a sinusoid conductance |

each tree has two ends (root, leaf) and one relation $p_\text{root}-p_\text{leaf}=R_t\,Q_t$ → every tree needs **two** known values among pressure / flow
:::
:::

# Challenges {#challenges background-color="#2b6cb0"}

## Challenges: model and numerics {#ch-model}

::: {.cards}
::: {.card}
**One common terminal pressure**

- all leaves of all trees are one node → the **capillary bed has no resistance**
- terminals cannot differ in pressure → flow distribution only from tree geometry
- first result (quad): leaf pressure 10.45 mmHg > P root 10 mmHg → **flow in P is reversed**
- alternative: leaf pressure per tree → $T-1$ rows fewer, closed with flow splits + total flow (see counting)
:::

::: {.card}
**Conditioning**

- $c \propto d^4$: diameters over 2–3 orders of magnitude → $c$ over **8–12 orders**
- mixed units in one matrix: $c$ (L/(Pa·s)), $\pm1$ rows, Pa on the right side
- → scale rows / unknowns (e.g. pressures in mmHg, $c$ normalised) before a direct solve
:::

::: {.card}
**Size and solver**

- $N \sim 10^6$ nodes per tree → sparse LU (`A \ b`, UMFPACK) is fine in memory, but slow to build if not compacted
- trees are **acyclic**: pressures can be computed tree by tree (resistances add up) in $O(N)$ — a check for the matrix solution
- validation: $Q_A : Q_P \approx 1 : 3$ (physiology), mass balance $\sum Q_\text{in} = \sum Q_\text{out}$
:::
:::
